panels.title: P1 · Sin emisiones: renovable y nuclear

targets.query: from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P1") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "P1")
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P1") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P2") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P2") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: mean)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P3") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: mean)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P3") |> last()

panels.title: P4 · Potencia instalada frente a generación

targets.query: from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P4" and r.metrica == "Generación por MW") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P4" and (r.metrica == "Potencia instalada" or r.metrica == "Generación")) |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P5" and r.metrica == "Saldo generación-demanda" and r.territorio == "$territorio") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P5" and r.metrica == "Ratio generación-demanda") |> last()
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P6") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: mean)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P6") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: mean)

from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P7" and r.pais == "$pais") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1mo, fn: sum)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.pregunta == "P7") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1y, fn: sum)
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis") |> count()
from(bucket: "$bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ree_analisis" and r.metrica == "revisar_valor_negativo") |> count()
